The small helpers that the other families share: points and boxes, Bézier curves, sorted and registry lists, lockable values, threads, platform folders, JSON files and pixel buffers.
Learn: [Threads](/use/learn/running/threads/), [Where JOID stores files](/use/learn/running/files/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`Bezier`](/reference/utilities/bezier/) | class | Computes the points of quadratic and cubic Bézier curves. |
| [`BoundingBox`](/reference/utilities/boundingbox/) | class | Mutable rectangle stored by its minimum and maximum corners, in design pixels. |
| [`IIndexedElement`](/reference/utilities/iindexedelement/) | interface | Element that gives its place in an `IndexedList`. |
| [`ImageUtils`](/reference/utilities/imageutils/) | class | Decodes an image with a chosen reader and prepares pixels with transparent areas for filtering. |
| [`IndexedList`](/reference/utilities/indexedlist/) | class | List kept sorted by the index of its elements, with equal indexes in insertion order. |
| [`JsonFiles`](/reference/utilities/jsonfiles/) | class | Reads and writes the JSON files of JOID safely: atomic writes, and a damaged file set aside instead of lost. |
| [`LockableValue`](/reference/utilities/lockablevalue/) | class | Mutable value that can be locked, after which its setters refuse to change it and point to the methods that return a copy. |
| [`PixelLayout`](/reference/utilities/pixellayout/) | enum | Order of the four bytes of a pixel in a buffer, to convert between buffers and ARGB `int` pixels. |
| [`Platform`](/reference/utilities/platform/) | enum | Operating system that JOID runs on, and where it keeps its cache there. |
| [`Point`](/reference/utilities/point/) | class | Immutable point of two or three `double` coordinates, compared by value. |
| [`Registry`](/reference/utilities/registry/) | class | Ordered list of registered values in which the most recent registration wins. |
| [`RenderThreadFuture`](/reference/utilities/renderthreadfuture/) | class | Future that completes on the render thread once the work it wraps is done, so its callbacks can touch the interface. |
| [`ThreadUtils`](/reference/utilities/threadutils/) | class | Creates daemon threads and runs a task on the render thread. |
